english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a document or electronic item proving someone’s identity, status, or entitlement.

exampleSentences.english: You need to show a credential at the entrance to prove you are entitled to go in.
exampleSentences.traditional: 入場嗰陣要出示證件，證明你有資格入去。
